svg.title: Where the money stops
svg.desc: Where the money stops. A horizontal band of $100 of Medicaid spending, narrowing left to right as it passes 5 phases. At federal and state shares, $100.76 remains in FY2030 against $100.76 in FY2024. At state agency, $98.75 remains in FY2030 against $100.00 in FY2024. At disbursements, $84.47 remains in FY2030 against $92.73 in FY2024. At claims to providers, $79.32 remains in FY2030 against $87.07 in FY2024. At beneficiaries, $78.33 remains in FY2030 against $86.92 in FY2024. Marked below the band: Provider tax limits, $1.25, at federal and state shares, carried by state budgets; Everything else, $1.06, at state agency, carried by enrollees; Work reporting, $4.11, at disbursements, carried by people who will not enroll; Six-month renewals, $0.75, at disbursements, carried by people who will not renew; Medicaid enrollment rule suspended, $1.04, at claims to providers, carried by people who would have had a paid claim; Directed payment caps, $0.85, at claims to providers, carried by hospitals, nursing facilities, academic centres; Medicare Savings rule suspended, $1.28, at beneficiaries, carried by dual eligibles.
